title: Thousand Flames

outfit_card.silhouette: Layered Chinese-inspired couture with a fitted high-collar bodice, voluminous gradient wide sleeves, and a flowing sheer over-robe with asymmetric cloud-like shoulder panels.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Gilded floral hairpins with enameled blue petals, cascading bead chains, a filigree lantern tassel, and delicate pearl-and-gem forehead fringe.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High mandarin collar with gold filigree trim, sheer organza overlay embroidered with pearl and crystal beadwork, wide gradient sleeves edged in pale green silk and ornate metallic borders.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Flowing floor-length skirt with gradient lilac-turquoise panels, layered sheer tulle over a structured petticoat, ornate waist sash with jade pendant, and concealed embroidered slippers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating floral petals, filigree lantern tassel accessory, and iridescent cloud-and-flame motifs woven into the sheer textiles.
